name: seis-source-provenance
description: Read-only file hashing and source, rights, and classification metadata for SEIS.

interface.shortDescription: Hash and classify local source files without uploading them.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, local-only SEIS provenance plugin that records relative paths, sizes, SHA-256 hashes, source classes, and rights-risk hints for a bounded file scan without network access or writes.
defaultPrompt: Create a bounded source provenance report.
Hash these files without uploading them.
